name: voxstudio
description: Session knowledge, transcription, voiceover and native video editing in one VoxStudio connection.

interface.shortDescription: Ask your sessions, transcribe and create media
interface.longDescription: Ask questions and read the relevant session details or matching sessions beside your chat. Transcribe media, create voiceovers and edit the native VoxStudio timeline through the same connection.
defaultPrompt: Ask my VoxStudio sessions and show the original evidence
